tbesh_html:
1) to kindle, burn, set on fire
1a) (Qal) to kindle
1b) (Niphal)
1b1) to be kindled
1b2) to be left desolate
1c) (Hiphil) to set on fire, kindle

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to burn or set on fire; figuratively, to desolate
strongs_1890.kjv_def: burn (up), be desolate, set (on) fire (fire), kindle.
